parameters.name: AssetDescription
parameters.description: Business knowledge content edited by users.

parameters.name: ColumnName
parameters.description: The name of the field. This parameter is used when the edited content is a field.

parameters.name: DbId
parameters.description: The ID of the physical database. You can call the [SearchDatabase](~~141876~~) operation to obtain the ID.

parameters.name: TableSchemaName
parameters.description: The schema name of the table, which is required only for SQL Server instances.
